title: kith-tui: crate scaffold + layout
description: Add a new binary crate kith-tui to the workspace. Set up ratatui + crossterm + tokio. Implement terminal init/teardown (raw mode, alternate screen), an async event loop using tokio::select! over crossterm EventStream + a 50ms render tick, and the fixed 3-panel layout: chat list (left ~25%), message thread (right ~75%), text input (bottom 3 lines), status bar (bottom 1 line). All panels show placeholder/hardcoded content — no real data yet. App exits cleanly on q or Ctrl-C.
